policy.purpose: Backend-independent performance intent for MusicIR v3. A technique may change note gate immediately; sampled-patch/keyswitch realization is selected separately through part.technique_map and instrument knowledge.
policy.custom_mapping: A score may use a custom technique name only when part.technique_map explicitly maps that name to an instrument realization.

sustain.summary: Let the note ring close to its full notated duration.

tenuto.summary: Hold nearly the full written value with a connected feel.

legato.summary: Overlap successive notes slightly when the instrument supports it.

marcato.summary: Accented, clearly separated attack with moderate sustain.

pizzicato.summary: Plucked-string articulation; route to a pizzicato patch when available.

palm_mute.summary: Short damped guitar/bass articulation; route to a muted patch when available.

tremolo.summary: Sustained tremolo texture; usually requires a dedicated sampled articulation.

bell.summary: Allow long decay for bell-like material.
